# metrics

<!-- Generated by tools/config-reference.py from libs/platform-pf/src/main/resources/META-INF/oidf-settings/metrics.json. Do not edit: change the catalogue, then run python3 tools/config-reference.py. -->

The settings of the `metrics` component of `libs/platform-pf`, read by package `com.pingidentity.ps.oidf.platform.pf.metrics`: generated from its catalogue, metrics.json, by `tools/config-reference.py`, and checked in CI. [How to read a row](README.md#reading-a-row).

Families: `OIDF_METRICS_`. A name under one of these that no catalogue declares is an unknown key.

Under the production profile a violation by one of these settings refuses `SSF` (components).

| Setting | Default | What it does | When it's wrong | Profile | Security |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `OIDF_METRICS_CLIENT_IDS` (system property `oidf.metrics.client.ids`, then env `OIDF_METRICS_CLIENT_IDS`) | Unset; a list | The PingFederate client ids, separated by spaces or commas, whose access tokens may scrape /agentic-identity/metrics in production without being bound to a key (no DPoP proof, no certificate binding): a scraper such as Prometheus, which can do neither, authenticating to PingFederate with a key it holds (the RFC 7523 JWT bearer grant, or private_key_jwt). Only the metrics.read route takes such a token, and only with oidf.metrics.read; every other operator route still refuses it. Unset, production refuses every unbound token, as on every route (U-0566) | **First request**: A * among the ids: refused with an ERROR naming the setting, and no client may scrape unbound - production refuses every unbound token | Any; refuses `OPERATOR_API` | Yes |
| `OIDF_METRICS_SAMPLE_SECONDS` (system property `oidf.metrics.sample.seconds`, then env `OIDF_METRICS_SAMPLE_SECONDS`) | `15`; a whole number, 5 to 300 | How often, in seconds, a node counts the SSF backlog (outbox, queued, held and dead SETs and the oldest of each) for /agentic-identity/metrics; one aggregate query a stage, each with a 2 s deadline | **First request**: Not a whole number from 5 to 300: refused with an ERROR naming the setting, and the backlog is sampled every 15 s | Any | No |
